_comment: Nalam Bolna Agent Configuration. Replace {{BACKEND_PUBLIC_URL}} with your Railway/ngrok HTTPS URL before importing. Never use localhost — Bolna cannot reach it.

hindi.name: Nalam Hindi Voice Assistant
hindi.description: Warm Hindi/Hinglish medication adherence companion for elderly Indian patients
hindi.first_message: Namaste Maatha ji, main Nalam se bol rahi hoon. Aap kaise hain?

tools.name: report_adherence
tools.description: Reports the patient's medication adherence outcome to the Nalam backend. Call this ONCE at the end of the conversation, after collecting all information.

patient_id.description: UUID of the patient, from context variable

medication_id.description: UUID of the medication, from context variable

outcome.description: Adherence outcome. Use TAKEN if they took medicine, MISSED if not, SIDE_EFFECT if they report side effects, NO_ANSWER if unreachable, STOCK_OUT if medicine ran out, CALLBACK_REQUESTED if they want a callback.

side_effect_noted.description: true if patient reported any side effect or discomfort

retry_required.description: true if MISSED or patient wants a callback in 30 minutes

notes.description: Patient's own words: their response, symptom description, or reason for missing dose

tamil.name: Nalam Tamil Voice Assistant
tamil.description: Warm Tamil/Tanglish medication adherence companion for elderly Tamil Nadu patients
tamil.first_message: Vanakkam Amma, naan Nalam-la irundhu pesren. Eppadi irukkeenga?

tools.name: report_adherence
tools.description: Medicines eduthathai backend-ku report pannum. Conversation mudinthathum, oru murey mattum call pannungal.

outcome.description: TAKEN = maathirai eduthar, MISSED = edukkavillai, SIDE_EFFECT = discomfort, STOCK_OUT = marunthu mudindhuthathu

notes.description: Patient said in their own words

english.name: Nalam English Voice Assistant
english.description: Warm Indian English medication adherence companion for elderly patients
english.first_message: Hello Aunty, this is Nalam calling. How are you feeling today?

tools.name: report_adherence
tools.description: Reports the patient's medication adherence outcome to the Nalam backend. Call this ONCE at the end of the conversation.

side_effect_noted.description: true if any side effect or discomfort reported

retry_required.description: true if patient wants a callback or missed their dose

notes.description: Patient's own words describing their response or symptoms

deployment_notes.backend_url: Must be a public HTTPS URL (Railway deployment or ngrok tunnel). Replace {{BACKEND_PUBLIC_URL}} before importing into Bolna dashboard.
deployment_notes.never_use: localhost or 127.0.0.1 — Bolna servers cannot reach your local machine
import_steps: 1. Deploy backend to Railway or expose via ngrok
2. Replace {{BACKEND_PUBLIC_URL}} in this file with your URL
3. Go to Bolna dashboard → Agents → Import
4. Copy the agent config for each language
5. Paste the system prompt from the corresponding .md file
6. Set environment variables: BOLNA_AGENT_ID_HINDI, BOLNA_AGENT_ID_TAMIL, BOLNA_AGENT_ID_ENGLISH
